name_input: SUZUKI MOTORCYCLE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; INTEGRA OVERSEAS PVT LTD; SUZUKI MOTORCYCLE INDIA PVT. LTD.; SUZUKI MOTORCYCLE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; SUZUKI MOTORCYCLE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; SUZUKI MOTORCYCLE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; SUZUKI MOTORCYCLE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
note: RISK-ONLY SCOPE. Research blocked by tooling failure: DuckDuckGo search backend returned 'Connection refused' for all queries; Bing HTML fallback returned only generic global Suzuki corporate pages (suzuki.com, globalsuzuki.com, Wikipedia) with no India-entity-specific records. No sanctions, court, regulator, rating or Russia/CIS-supply evidence could be retrieved, therefore all fields are null rather than inferred. What was actually verified: the official website suzukimotorcycle.co.in resolves and presents itself as 'Suzuki Motorcycle India' (Indian two-wheeler market: Access, Burgman, Avenis, Gixxer, V-Strom, Hayabusa, e-Access) - this confirms an operating Indian-market presence but is a self-published site, not a risk record. NOT verified and explicitly not asserted: (a) sanctions exposure - no OFAC SDN / UN / EU / UK / BIS Entity List screening was completed; note that the Suzuki group is a Japanese multinational and no public listing of this Indian subsidiary was found, but absence of a hit here is a research gap, not a clearance; (b) Indian court cases - no NCLT/NCLAT/HC/consumer-forum docket was retrieved, party role and status unknown; (c) regulator actions and negative news - none retrieved, no dates available; (d) credit rating - no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings action retrieved, status and date unknown; (e) supplies to Russia or the CIS - no evidence either way; the Suzuki group publicly exited/curtailed Russia-related activity at parent level in 2022-2023, but no India-entity shipment or re-export evidence was found and none is claimed. Data-quality flag for the batch owner: the name field concatenates seven variants and mixes two distinct legal entities - 'Suzuki Motorcycle India Private Limited' (the claimed legal entity) and 'Integra Overseas Pvt Ltd', which appears to be a separate trading party (possibly the exporter/intermediary). Risk screening must be run separately for Integra Overseas Pvt Ltd; it was not screened here and no conclusion about it is implied. Also note the declared industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy/mining) and declared HS 848240 (ball bearings) are inconsistent with an actual two-wheeler manufacturer - flagged for the HS/identity team, not a risk finding and not a rejection ground per project rules. Recommended next step: re-run sanctions (OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS), NCLT/NCLAT and consumer-forum, and rating-agency checks once search access is restored, and screen Integra Overseas Pvt Ltd as its own subject.
